question: In news in 2025, what is the main function of the ‘Sachet’ app?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Real-time disaster alerts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sachet app** is specifically designed to provide **real-time disaster alerts** to individuals and communities, helping them prepare for and respond to natural or man-made disasters effectively.
 
• It offers **instant notifications** about potential hazards such as earthquakes, floods, cyclones, landslides, and other emergencies, ensuring timely dissemination of critical information.
 
• The app integrates with **meteorological data** and disaster management agencies to provide accurate and region-specific alerts.
 
• Users can customize settings to receive alerts for their **specific location** or other regions of interest.
 
• This application is a key tool in **disaster preparedness and mitigation**, minimizing the impact of disasters by enabling early action.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Real-time disaster management:**

 
 
• Real-time disaster management involves the use of technology to monitor, predict, and alert populations about disasters as they occur or before they happen.
 
• It includes collecting data from sources like weather stations, satellites, sensors, and geospatial technology.
 
• Applications like **Sachet** are instrumental in implementing real-time disaster alerts.
 
• Example: Early warning systems for cyclones have reduced fatalities significantly in cyclone-prone areas like Odisha, India.
 
 
 
• **Integration of technology in disaster alerts:**
 
 
• Technologies like **AI, machine learning, and IoT** are leveraged to enhance the accuracy of disaster prediction models.
 
• Smartphones with GPS technology aid in **localized disaster warnings**.
 
• Social media platforms and apps like Sachet play a significant role in disseminating information quickly.
 
 
 
• **Other similar disaster management apps:**
 
 
• **MyShake:** An app that provides earthquake early warnings in California.
 
• **Disaster Alert:** Developed by the Pacific Disaster Center, it provides information about active hazards worldwide.
 
• **NDMA App:** Launched by the National Disaster Management Authority in India, it focuses on disaster preparedness and mitigation.
 
 
 
• **Importance of disaster alerts:**
 
 
• Early alerts can save lives by providing enough time for evacuation and preparation.
 
• They reduce economic losses by minimizing damage to property and infrastructure.
 
• Alerts foster a culture of disaster preparedness and resilience among communities.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key features of the Sachet app:**

 
 
• Provides **location-specific alerts** based on geospatial mapping and user preferences.
 
• Includes **multilingual support** to cater to diverse user groups in disaster-prone areas.
 
• Offers **educational resources** on disaster preparedness, including evacuation plans and safety tips.
 
• Integrates with local and national disaster response systems for seamless coordination.
 
 
 
• **Global disaster trends:**
 
 
• Climate change has led to an increase in the **frequency and intensity of natural disasters** like hurricanes, floods, and wildfires.
 
• Regions like South Asia and the Pacific are particularly vulnerable due to their **geographical location** and socio-economic conditions.
 
• Efforts are being made globally to strengthen **early warning systems** and disaster resilience programs.
